A published human pilot is not proof that BPC-157 is generally safe or heals injuries. The pilot reviewed here observed two people over three days; FDA separately identifies important safety uncertainties.[1][2]

What did the pilot observe?
+

The 2025 intravenous pilot included two participants who had previously received BPC-157. The authors reported no adverse effects or measurable changes in the tested biomarkers during the short observation.[1]

What does that leave unanswered?
+

An uncontrolled two-person pilot cannot estimate uncommon harms or establish long-term safety. It did not demonstrate healing of tendons, muscles or gastrointestinal disease. This brief is not an inventory of all human research.[1]

What does FDA flag?
+

FDA identifies limited safety information and potential immune-response and peptide-impurity concerns for proposed uses. These uncertainties do not prove a particular injury will occur, but they prevent a blanket safety assurance.[2]

A published human pilot is not proof that BPC-157 is generally safe or heals injuries. The pilot reviewed here observed two people over three days; FDA separately identifies important safety uncertainties.[1][2]

What did the pilot observe?
+

The 2025 intravenous pilot included two participants who had previously received BPC-157. The authors reported no adverse effects or measurable changes in the tested biomarkers during the short observation.[1]

What does that leave unanswered?
+

An uncontrolled two-person pilot cannot estimate uncommon harms or establish long-term safety. It did not demonstrate healing of tendons, muscles or gastrointestinal disease. This brief is not an inventory of all human research.[1]

What does FDA flag?
+

FDA identifies limited safety information and potential immune-response and peptide-impurity concerns for proposed uses. These uncertainties do not prove a particular injury will occur, but they prevent a blanket safety assurance.[2]

No retail vial, purity certificate or treatment protocol is evaluated here. Scientific and human editorial review remain pending.
